notes.title: Improvements to script readability
notes.content: QOL update: We have gone over the script to correct spelling and grammar issues, as reported by players, without changing the content of the game itself. Thank you for the feedback!

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed the "heroes and fools" achievement.
[*] Fixed one of Zerebeth's flags so the pond scene correctly registers whether Einar purchased him at the beginning or not.
[/list]
